segments.name: Systems (Etch, Deposition, Other Equipment)
segments.description: Leading-edge semiconductor processing equipment including etch (Flex, Kiyo, Syndion, Versys), deposition (ALTUS, SABRE, SOLA, VECTOR, SPEED, Striker ALD), and clean/metrology systems

segments.name: Customer Support and Other (CSBG)
segments.description: Service contracts, spare parts, equipment upgrades, Reliant non-leading-edge systems. Installed base surpassed 100,000 chambers. Record $7.2B CSBG revenue in FY2025

segment_detail_by_technology.name: Etch Equipment
segment_detail_by_technology.note: 100% share in 3D NAND channel etch (being challenged by TEL)

segment_detail_by_technology.name: Deposition Equipment
segment_detail_by_technology.market_position: Clear #2 behind Applied Materials in overall deposition
segment_detail_by_technology.note: ALD revenue grew 50%+ in 2025 from $1B in 2024, driven by GAA transition. ALTUS Halo launched Feb 2025 — first ALD tool for molybdenum deposition

segment_detail_by_technology.name: Clean & Other
products: Da Vinci / DV-Prime / EOS / SP (wafer clean)
segment_detail_by_technology.market_position: Niche positions in clean and metrology

recent_quarter.note: Record revenue and margins, AI-driven growth

geographic_breakdown.note: Largest market; expected to decline below 30% in future due to export controls
Samsung and SK Hynix spending on HBM and advanced DRAM
TSMC advanced node expansion (N3, N2 GAA)
CHIPS Act-driven fab construction (Intel, Micron, TSMC Arizona)
Estimated residual; EU Chips Act driving future growth

key_customers: TSMC (largest foundry customer, N2 GAA transition driving ALD demand)
key_suppliers: Thousands of global suppliers for specialized materials and components
2024 Supplier Excellence Award winners recognized for innovation and sustainability
Supply chain spans U.S., India, Korea, and Taiwan R&D/engineering labs

concentration_risk.customer_concentration: High — top 3-5 customers (TSMC, Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron, Intel) represent majority of revenue. Semiconductor equipment is inherently concentrated due to oligopolistic customer base
concentration_risk.geographic_concentration: High — China alone is 33.7% of revenue, creating geopolitical/export control risk. Top 3 regions (China, Korea, Taiwan) = 74.7% of revenue
concentration_risk.supplier_concentration: Moderate — diversified across thousands of global suppliers, but specialized components may have limited sourcing options

etch_equipment_market.source: Average of Mordor Intelligence ($36.8B), Research and Markets ($42.6B), KBV Research ($39.8B) forecasts for 2030
etch_equipment_market.note: Estimates range from $36.8B to $56.1B by 2030-2034 depending on source

total_wfe_market.note: Total semiconductor equipment sales (including non-WFE) forecast at $133B in 2025, $145B in 2026, $156B in 2027

lrcx_sam_share_of_wfe.note: Management targets SAM expansion via GAA, advanced packaging, backside power delivery. FY2025 SAM share achieved mid-30s% of WFE, progressing toward multiyear high-30s target

ald_market.note: Lam's ALD revenue crossed $1B in 2024, grew 50%+ in 2025. Key growth driver from GAA transistor adoption

nand_channel_etch_market.note: Lam currently holds ~100% share but TEL developing competing technology

advanced_packaging_and_gaa.note: GAA + advanced packaging combined shipments expected to exceed $3B in 2025, up from >$1B each in 2024
